title: Accurate Measures of Vaccination and Concerns of Vaccine Holdouts from Web Search Logs
benchmark_measurement: The study measured the prevalence of 'religious concerns' as a category of vaccine hesitancy among web search users, identified through an ontology of vaccine-related URLs clicked by 'vaccine holdouts' versus 'early adopters'.
findings: Vaccine holdouts were found to be significantly more interested in 'religious concerns' about the vaccine compared to early adopters, with a 2.5 times higher likelihood of clicking on related URLs. This interest was more pronounced among holdouts from lower-income areas. As holdouts moved closer to expressing intent to get vaccinated, their search interest in religious concerns and exemptions dropped sharply.
